init_wandb_singleton: initialize a WandBSingletonLogger instance with config, run_id, run_name, log_dir, project, and entity parameters
log_metrics_wandb: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the WandBSingletonLogger singleton with optional step and commit flags
watch_model_gradients: watch a PyTorch model parameters and gradients with WandBLogger or WandBSingletonLogger at a specified log frequency
log_table_wandb: log a wandb Table with column names and row data to the current wandb run using WandBSingletonLogger
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics for a PyTorch tensor using the log_stats convenience function with a prefix string
